lines.criterion: States tables done and total, the 2 GB export blocker, three blocked tables, the next step, owner and target exactly as supplied.
No invented facts: no figures, dates, people, causes or promises beyond the supplied facts.
Leads with where the work stands, then the blocker and its effect, then the next step and owner.
120-160 words in two or three short paragraphs with no headings or bullet list.
Plain active sentences in a restrained internal tone; no hype or filler.
